ideas.title: Develop a geometric predictive model with an explicit observation-to-belief transition
ideas.nextStep: DESIGN AND IMPLEMENT METHOD 2. Read the full card and prior-art.md. Motivation: imagined futures must not become received evidence. Extend ObservationBranchModel into a trained action-conditioned geometric/visual predictor with latent observation branches and likelihood-coupled posteriors. Check Branch-JEPA, UWM-JEPA, predictive-state/Bayesian planning and related primary sources; Bayes' rule itself is established. Implement actual visual training plus a planner that uses possible future observations before choosing continuation actions. Compare unconstrained latent mixtures and learned Bayes-filter baselines; evaluate unseen geometry, occlusion, speed and measured latency. Preserve METHOD.md, checkpoint, ablations and limitations. CPU/small model or RTX 3060 Ti within 60% VRAM. Novelty and usefulness are uncertain; a confidence calibration table is not the requested final artifact.

ideas.title: Develop a reconstruction-conditioned generator that co-trains a sensing policy
ideas.nextStep: DESIGN AND IMPLEMENT METHOD 3. Motivation: a partial real-to-sim reconstruction represents several possible worlds. Build an alternating capture-constrained completion generator and recurrent policy learner with an information-matched teacher and explicit reveal actions. Audit ReMiDi/PAIRED, adversarial neural rendering, Vid2Sim and existing Gaussian navigation sources.
